en: Colorized panoramic view of a coastal city and harbor with many warships anchored in calm water. The foreground shows a fortified seafront with bastions, trees, and dense historic buildings; in the distance are low mountains across the bay. A circular postal cancellation mark with Greek text and a partial date appears in the sky area, and the bottom right bears the printed website credit "www.elia.org.gr".
